section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a study investigating Latent Inhibition (LI) and IQ as factors of creative achievement, referencing 'Study 1' for context. Eighty-two of 96 participants completed IQ tasks, with a mean IQ of 124.6. For a subsample of 46 participants, LI and IQ scores were regressed on CAQ scores, revealing that negative LI and positive IQ scores jointly predicted 20% of the variance in CAQ scores.
